answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce a new task of message rephrasing in task-oriented dialog.

answer_2.quote: Our first metric is the Exact Match (EM) accuracy... We also use EM any... We also use SARI, which is commonly used for text-editing tasks.

answer_4.quote: We observed that the collected queries contained two distinct types of messaging content: 1) where the content needs to be rephrased (REPHRASE) and 2) where the content should be used verbatim (EXACT). As such, the utterances were sent to another set of annotators to mark the message content in the utterances... We asked three annotators to independently rephrase the utterances.
answer_4.guideline: annotators were asked to rephrase the message content in a way that it would be natural to send to the second user without any additional context... minimally rephrase a sentence, e.g., keeping the words and attributes (e.g., formality) of the original content as much as possible.
